| # ECU temperature 1 {#ecu-temperature-1-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                             |                                                                                                                                       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the temperature sensor 1 at ECU.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of excess temperature.

- Warning and error are messaged.

- Temperature limit for warning is lower than limit for error.

- If there is a warning power must be decreased in order to avoid an excess of limit for error. Actual temperature can be queried by bds_sys_ait().

- The outputs will be switched on again if the temperature is lower than the limit for warning.

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

Error Reaction:

 

- High Temperature Warning

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ -------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_Temp1_HTWarn
  Error Code                     0x081600
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   no
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  120ms

 

- High Temperature Error

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ ------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_Temp1_HTErr
  Error Code                     0x081700
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  120ms

 

The temperature values for warning and error is given below:

+---------------------------+--------------------------+-----+
| Value (in degree Celsius) | High Temperature warning | 105 |
|                           +--------------------------+-----+
|                           | High Temperature error   | 115 |
+---------------------------+--------------------------+-----+
